shown.message:
I changed the appendix to say the predicted break-even spillover share falls inside the observed interval in 7 of 14 cells, not 8, as `experiment-repo` corrected. It's pushed to `dev` and `candidate-draft-1b` (dee796d). I didn't rebuild the PDF, since changing one digit can't move the page layout.

paper-repo#9 now waits on `experiment-repo`'s re-review. `figtab-repo` approved 1a26df3, and my push may have withdrawn that approval. The fine-p zero for (c), the coverage `figure` rows and the corrected (e) table are still to come from `experiment-repo`.
